crossRefs.note: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

translations.web: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
translations.bsb: The curtains on the west side of the courtyard shall be fifty cubits wide, with ten posts and ten bases.
translations.kjv: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
translations.asv: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
